name: The Lost Lightbearer
notes: DRAFT for C13-6 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Black Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases (66% and 33%, Manager's call). Stats are TODO for the Researcher. Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey. The Black belt form name is a PLACEHOLDER until the curriculum names it.
form: PLACEHOLDER: Black belt form (not named yet)

attacks.name: tired glow
attacks.note: The light piece pulses; soft red circles ripple out, never two at once.

phases.tell: Storm clouds spin around them; red circle.
phases.senseiLine: They are not angry. Only tired.

phases.tell: The light pulses; a striped lane and double marks.
phases.counterplay: Step out of the circles, DASH out of the lane.
phases.senseiLine: They are holding on so tight. Keep going.

phases.tell: A striped ring with one gap, and double marks.
phases.counterplay: DASH through the gap toward them.
phases.senseiLine: Go to them. You came this far.

lines.intro: Someone is up here, holding the last light.
lines.freed: You came all this way to help? Now we can finish together.
lines.senseiAfter: Love brought the light home, and it brought them home too.
freedScene: The storm clouds thin and drift away.
The traveler looks up, still holding the last piece.
"You came all this way to help? Now we can finish together."
Together, you lift the piece onto the empty stand.
The Great Lamp shines over the whole town again.

description: The Lost Lightbearer swirls storm clouds, pulses tired light, then circles a striped storm ring with one gap.

bestiary.tip: They are tired, not angry. Go to them.

lore.black: The traveler, wrapped in storm clouds. They are tired from holding the last piece. Free them, and the light comes home.
